archimate:Outcome.name: Improved Targeting (lower inclusion/exclusion errors)
archimate:Outcome.documentation:
The "Improved Targeting" goal is a precision-driven healthcare objective focused on using demographic, clinical, and social data to accurately identify and direct specialized interventions to the specific patient populations most likely to benefit from them.
Its purpose is to maximize the impact of limited healthcare resources by focusing preventive services, chronic disease management, and specialized outreach on high-risk, high-need, or historically underserved individuals.
Example: A public health department achieves this goal by analyzing local EHR data to locate neighborhoods with the highest pediatric asthma emergency rates, allowing them to target those exact blocks with home-based allergen-reduction programs.
